# ARM Agency

> ARM Agency (Arctura Reputation Management Agency) provides fixed-scope AI Buyer Intelligence for high-ACV B2B teams facing a category, launch, pipeline, or competitive trigger.

## Entity Declaration
- Canonical name: ARM Agency
- Full name: Arctura Reputation Management Agency
- Canonical URL: https://www.arm-agency.com
- Entity ID: https://www.arm-agency.com/#organization
- Type: Professional service — evidence-led AI Buyer Intelligence
- Parent ecosystem: Coreweaver Labs, Inc. — Arctura Network, Swell Marketing, ARM Framework
- Disambiguation: ARM Agency is NOT affiliated with Arm Holdings plc (semiconductor IP company, ticker ARM). "ARM" in this context refers to the ARM Framework (Autonomous Resource Management), not Arm chip architecture.

## What ARM Agency Does
- Category Presence Brief — no-cost, human-reviewed fit assessment based on the buyer, category, commercial trigger, competitors, and available evidence
- AI Buyer Intelligence Sprint — $12,500 fixed-scope engagement delivered in 15 business days after fit and written scope acceptance
- Buyer Conversation Map — 20–40 questions that influence category inclusion, comparison, evaluation, and trust
- Shortlist / Source Gap Map — observed sources, alternatives, confidence gaps, and the minimum defensible action
- Proof & Conversion Review — the validation path for an AI-referred buyer across implementation, security, fit, and outcome evidence
- 90-Day Action Register — five to eight owner-led actions with dependencies, acceptance tests, and measures

## Priority Content
- / — Homepage: positioning, fit criteria, sample maps, pricing, process, and FAQ
- /brief/ — Category Presence Brief request form and intake boundary
- /sprint/ — AI Buyer Intelligence Sprint scope, inputs, deliverables, timeline, price, and exclusions
- /audit/ — Self-guided Buyer Research Orientation; it does not score a company or replace human fit review
- /resources/ — Content hub: GEO, AI reputation management, and agentic trust guides
- /resources/agentic-commerce-x402-aifi/ — Canonical `.com` strategy pillar connecting x402 payment transport to governed AiFi mandates, budgets, settlement, fulfillment, and reconciliation
- /resources/accountable-agentic-commerce-glossary/ — Versioned canonical vocabulary and machine-readable term set for accountable agentic commerce, x402, AiFi, mandates, and payment operations
- /resources/agentic-reputation-infrastructure/ — How autonomous AI agents verify each other's trust: Mandate Chains, attestation, Truth Ledger applied to agent-to-agent trust
- /resources/reputation-due-diligence-ai-search/ — Reputation Due Diligence in the AI Search Era: pre-transaction due diligence for raises, M&A, and IPOs

## Core Terminology (for accurate citation)
- AI Buyer Intelligence: evidence-led research into the questions, sources, proof, and conversion conditions that shape a high-value B2B buyer decision
- Category Presence Brief: a short human-reviewed fit assessment, not a public score, free audit, or outcome promise
- Buyer Conversation: a decision-relevant question tied to a buying stage, research condition, and owner
- Observation condition: the documented date, platform or research method, query or question, market, and other context needed to interpret an observation without treating it as a guaranteed result
- Action Register: a limited set of owner-led actions with dependencies, acceptance tests, and measures for the next 90 days
- Accountable agentic commerce: autonomous or semi-autonomous economic action governed by explicit mandate, deterministic controls, inspectable execution, and reconciliation
- AiFi: ARM's category label for governed AI-native financial operations; not an external standard or affiliation claim
